consent.title: Cookies
consent.text: We use essential cookies to run this site. With your permission, we'd also like to use analytics and marketing cookies to improve it and measure our ads. You can change your choice at any time.
consent.essentialText: Needed for the site to work, such as security and remembering your cookie choice.
consent.analyticsText: Helps us understand which pages are useful. Uses Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity.
consent.marketingText: Measures our LinkedIn ads and shows relevant ads on LinkedIn.

content.notTranslated: This page is not yet available in Arabic, so it is shown in English.

industries.title: Industries
industries.metaTitle: Industries We Serve in Qatar | Fuerte
industries.metaDescription: IT, ELV and cyber security for government, banking, education, hospitality, oil and gas, healthcare and residential sites in Qatar.
industries.lead: Every sector runs on the same building systems, but each has its own rules, risks and pace. Choose yours to see how we work.

insights.title: Insights
insights.metaTitle: Insights: Qatar IT, ELV & Compliance Guides | Fuerte
insights.metaDescription: Practical guides on MoI SSD CCTV approval, PDPPL compliance and structured cabling standards in Qatar, from Fuerte's engineers.
insights.lead: Practical guides from our engineers on approvals, compliance and the standards behind the systems we build.
